candidates.name: liver metastasis
support_spans: Thirteen months after surgery, follow-up CT revealed a 25 mm lesion in segment 8 of the liver.
CTA demonstrated a liver tumor with two components: a solid portion that enhanced in the early phase and washed out in the delayed phase, and a cystic component.
CTAP showed absence of the right portal vein and a perfusion defect throughout the right lobe, suggestive of portal vein tumor thrombus.
candidates.why: The patient has a history of adenocarcinoma of the ascending colon and now presents with a liver lesion and portal vein tumor thrombus, which are common sites of metastasis for colorectal cancer.

candidates.name: Hepatocellular carcinoma
support_spans: a liver tumor with two components: a solid portion that enhanced in the early phase and washed out in the delayed phase
PIVKA-II were all within normal limits
candidates.why: The patient has a liver tumor with characteristics suggestive of hepatocellular carcinoma, such as early enhancement and delayed washout, and normal tumor markers.
